headline: Colts Want 2nd-Round Pick Plus More For RB Jonathan Taylor
summary: The Colts began a fire sale this week, trading away guard Quenton Nelson and defensive tackle DeForest Buckner. More moves are expected with running back Jonathan Taylor among the other players who could be dealt before the deadline. headline: 49ers Reacquire DT DeForest Buckner
summary: A fire sale is in full swing in Indianapolis, which traded potential Hall of Fame guard Quenton Nelson to Seattle earlier Tuesday. summary: To kick off a two-trade Tuesday, the rebuilding Colts sent perennial Pro Bowl guard Quenton Nelson to the Seahawks for a third-round pick next year and a fifth-rounder in 2028. headline: Montez Sweat returns to Bears following 'devastating' 2-game suspension
summary: Bears DE Montez Sweat is back with the team following his "devastating" two-game suspension violating the NFL's performance enhancing substances policy.

headline: Report: Lamar Jackson is expected to return Sunday
summary: Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson has not played since Oct. 4, missing the past three games with a high ankle sprain.

headline: Giants place RB Tyrone Tracy Jr. on IR with hamstring injury
summary: The Giants are placing RB Tyrone Tracy Jr. on injured reserve with a hamstring injury, with Devin Singletary expected to play a bigger role on offense.
